speaker: James White
claim: Continued scholarly quotation of classical authors shows that a sufficiently clear text can be used despite acknowledged uncertainty.
warrant: White presses whether Ehrman still cites Suetonius and treats the surviving form as usable evidence.
inference: Historical use therefore does not require perfect recovery of every original word.
